components.about.content.aboutUs: Feng Dance School has more than 30 years of professional dance performance and teaching history in Canada. At present, Feng Dance School offers ballet, jazz, jazz funk, Chinese dance, hip-hop and flexibility training classes, taught by professional dance teachers. Feng Dance focuses on providing the proper professional training of dance skills. In addition to dance skills training, each class will also learn dance combinations. Feng Dance believes that everyone can dance, and its purpose is to cultivate children's interests, enhance their self-confidence and develop their dance potentials.
components.about.content.ourTeam.directo: Tao has been involved in music and dance performance since childhood and has more than 30 years of experience in dance performance, teaching, arts organization, and event production. She also has a background in competitive gymnastics and has won medals in university-level competitions.{linebreak}{linebreak}Tao is currently the Director of the Oriental Dance Troupe of Ottawa. She has organized and overseen numerous cultural performances, including Chinese New Year productions at Centrepointe Theatre and The Charm of Oriental Dance and Music at Algonquin Commons Theatre. She also has extensive stage-management experience.
components.about.content.ourTeam.instruc: Founder and Director,{linebreak}Ballet Teacher and Choreographer

At the age of 12, Mr. Feng auditioned successfully to train for professional ballet in The Affiliated School of Beijing Dance Academy (BDA).  He was subsequently admitted officially to BDA as the first cohort of undergraduates in the Department of Ballet where he trained under the tutelage of such famous dance educators as Mr. Jinrong Cao (former President of The Affiliated School of the BDA), Professor Jiahong Wang (invited expert of Central Ballet), and Professor Hao Qu (former Chair of the Department of Ballet of the BDA) and obtained a B.A. in Dance Education (Ballet). More than ten years of professional training has given him a solid foundation and outstanding stage performance in ballet.{linebreak}{linebreak}He performed professionally in a leading role with Beijing Dance Academy Ballet Company (merged with Central Ballet of China in 1984), Les Ballet Jazz de Montreal, and Ottawa Ballet. He played numerous main characters in classical ballets as well as neo-classical and contemporary masterpieces, for example, “Swan Lake”, “Don Quixote” pas de deux, “Giselle” pas de deux, “La Bayadere” (solo), “Coppelia” (solo), “Tin Soldier” (solo), etc.  He danced with acclaimed dancers such as Frank Austyn and Karen Kain, and toured across China, United States, Canada, Europe, and Asia on many occasions.{linebreak}{linebreak}While at Les Ballet Jazz de Montreal, he was the company’s ballet master in charge of teaching the daily ballet classes and routine training. After he retired from the dance company, he devoted himself to ballet teaching for more than 30 years in China, Vancouver, Toronto, Montreal, and the National Capital Region, becoming one of the few well-known and popular dance teachers in Ottawa and Outaouais. He was a guest ballet teacher in the Ballet Department of Beijing Dance Academy and provided significant support to Professor Hao Qu in producing the Beijing Dance Academy ballet syllabus. Mr. Feng has extensive experience in teaching both RAD and open ballet, and character dance, choreography, helping students prepare for dance competitions. Many of his students have become professional dancers and excellent choreographers.

Abbie has more than 21 years of dance training and performance experience, with a particular passion for ballet and contemporary dance. She holds a Bachelor degree in Dance at York University, specializing in performance and choreography. She has completed the RAD Advanced examination and Vaganova Grade 7, and has continued her training with Ballet Jörgen, Canada’s National Ballet School, and the École supérieure de ballet du Québec.{linebreak}{linebreak}Abbie also holds an Acro Dance teaching certification and has experience teaching at dance studios and figure skating clubs across Canada. She creates a positive and inclusive classroom where students are encouraged to explore dance creatively and develop confidence and individuality.

Wendy began her dance training at the age of three and studied ballet, tap, and jazz for 15 years. She competed extensively and earned awards at regional and national competitions, as well as completing the RAD Grade 8 and Advanced Foundation examinations.{linebreak}{linebreak}Since 2019, Wendy has been a member of Unit One, a K-pop dance team at the University of Ottawa, and has served as the team’s captain since 2023. She also has experience in choreography and teaching hip-hop. Wendy brings strong technical training, performance experience, and a passion for dance to her teaching.{linebreak}{linebreak}Wendy brings a strong technical foundation, extensive performance experience, and a genuine passion for dance to her teaching. She is dedicated to helping students develop their skills, confidence, and love of dance.

Nicole began dancing in China at the age of three and continued her training in Toronto and Ottawa. At Forward Dance Academy, she trained in jazz, contemporary, tap, ballet, and street dance, while also participating in numerous competitions and performances and earning multiple awards.{linebreak}{linebreak}Nicole teaches K-pop and Jazz Funk at Feng Dance School. Fluent in both Chinese and English, she creates a comfortable and engaging environment for young students. With her diverse dance background and enthusiasm for teaching, Nicole enjoys sharing her love of dance and helping students build confidence and develop their skills.

Kateleen began training in rhythmic gymnastics at age eight, competing at the provincial level for eight consecutive years and representing Ontario at national competitions for two years. She earned multiple medals and was named an Ottawa Outstanding Athlete in 2016.{linebreak}{linebreak}Alongside gymnastics, Kateleen trained in ballet, jazz, and Chinese dance, developing a particular strength in jazz and contemporary dance. She continued dancing regularly throughout university and is currently a Ph. D. candidate at the University of Toronto. Her years of gymnastics and dance training have developed her strong discipline, perseverance, and determination, qualities she brings to both her teaching and her own continued growth.

Giselle is a passionate dance educator and accomplished dancer with extensive professional training in ballet, jazz, tap, and contemporary dance. She trained in ballet with Mr. Feng Ping before being accepted into Canada’s National Ballet School, where she studied RAD, Vaganova, and Cecchetti ballet methodologies.{linebreak}{linebreak}With extensive competition and teaching experience, Giselle is dedicated to helping young dancers develop strong technique, confidence, and artistry. She is also an accomplished choreographer. Her Lyrical Dance and ballet works for Feng Dance School’s competition team received multiple awards during the 2024–2026 competition seasons, including Judges’ Choice and overall first and second place awards.

components.programs.content: Feng Dance offers a wide range of dance programs, including ballet fundamentals, flexibility training, RAD ballet examination classes, lyrical and contemporary dance, Chinese dance, Acro, Jazz, K-pop and Hip Hop. Our programs are designed for students of all levels, with recreational, pre-competitive, and competitive streams.{linebreak}{linebreak}Feng Dance emphasizes systematic and comprehensive training in dance technique, musicality, and performance skills. Our goal is to provide children with professional and structured training from the very beginning, helping them develop their dance potential, cultivate a lifelong love of dance, and build confidence, discipline, and an elegant sense of poise.
